summary: Anonymous profile lock screen tested end-to-end via web preview (390x844). All 21 assertions PASSED. Anonymous users see full-screen 'PROFILO BLOCCATO' lock with @nickname, explanatory body, primary 'REGISTRATI ORA ›' CTA and secondary 'Esci dalla sessione anonima' link. Tapping the CTA logs out and navigates to /auth (verified Populus auth screen with 'Accedi'/'Registrati'). Registered users still see the normal profile UI (avatar, edit button, badge, prefs, history). No console errors captured. Backend /api/auth/anonymous confirmed working with {nickname} body.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx is 725 lines — consider splitting the edit-modal into a separate component (non-blocking).

Onboarding validation: /api/auth/me/profile rejected favorite_categories:['politics'] with 400 'Categorie non valide'. Not part of this task, but the accepted category slugs are opaque to callers; unrelated to lock screen but flagged for main agent awareness.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral anon user (anontest<epoch>) and one email user (reg<epoch>@test.com). No cleanup needed for test-scoped data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web-storage bridge for auth: set BOTH localStorage['faide_token'] and localStorage['@AsyncStorage:faide_token'] to JSON.stringify(token) before navigating. AsyncStorage web shim reads the '@AsyncStorage:' prefixed key; the app's secureGet falls through to AsyncStorage.getItem. Wait ~5s after /profile navigation for AuthContext to hydrate and refreshMe() to complete.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Assertions covered: profile-screen visible, anon-lock-screen visible, 'PROFILO BLOCCATO' + 'REGISTRATI ORA' + @nickname text, 0 counts for profile-avatar/badge/edit-button/bio/preferences-btn/prefs-section/profile-admin-link, anon-register-btn + anon-logout-btn visible, CTA tap → /auth with Accedi/Registrati rendered, registered-user regression: profile-screen visible, anon-lock-screen absent, profile-avatar/edit-button/badge present.
